title: Impl: add prepare_workspace(root) gated external entrypoint via __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ (GREEN)
acceptance_criteria: harness/state_reconciler.py gains prepare_workspace(root) -> WorkspaceStatus, appended additively via the R-ANCHOR __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ pattern (no whole-file reproduction, no raw-editing of semantic markers).
prepare_workspace enforces ownership / allowlist / dirty (fail-CLOSED: non-git root treated DIRTY and refused) / STAGED_UNMERGED gates before any mutation.
prepare_workspace acquires the shared state_reconcile.lock and delegates report/apply to cleanup_state (it is an alias, not a reimplementation).
Staging-worktree reclamation is scoped: siblings are verified still registered and a bare `git worktree prune` is NEVER invoked.

spec.objective: Implement prepare_workspace(root) -> WorkspaceStatus as the fail-closed external entrypoint/alias over cleanup_state in harness/state_reconciler.py, satisfying the oracle. Append via the additive __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ R-ANCHOR block; enforce all gates; acquire the one shared lock; perform scoped staging-worktree reclamation only.
functional_requirements: Add prepare_workspace(root) -> WorkspaceStatus to harness/state_reconciler.py strictly via the additive __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ R-ANCHOR block — no whole-file rewrite and no raw-editing of semantic markers.
Enforce the ownership and allowlist gates, refusing any root that fails either, before any mutation.
Make the dirty check fail CLOSED: a non-git root is treated DIRTY and refused; do not trust target_bootstrap._is_dirty's clean-on-non-git answer; dirty git roots are also refused.
Enforce the STAGED_UNMERGED gate, refusing roots with staged-unmerged entries.
Acquire the shared state_reconcile_lock(state_dir) context manager (the one shared lock) and then delegate the report/apply to cleanup_state rather than reimplementing disk rmtree/compaction.
Perform scoped staging-worktree reclamation only — verify siblings are still registered and NEVER invoke a bare `git worktree prune`.
spec.interfaces: prepare_workspace(root) -> WorkspaceStatus in harness/state_reconciler.py; alias over cleanup_state(root, *, mode="report"|"apply") -> WorkspaceStatus; serializes under state_reconcile_lock(state_dir). Consumes the disk reapers (from stale-disk-reapers) only indirectly through cleanup_state.
edge_cases: Non-git root: refuse as DIRTY (fail-CLOSED) even though target_bootstrap._is_dirty returns clean.
Clean owned + allowlisted git root with a stale staging worktree and a still-registered sibling: reclaim only the stale staging worktree, leave the registered sibling intact, no bare prune.
Staged-unmerged index: refuse via STAGED_UNMERGED gate.
Concurrent caller: serialize on the single shared state_reconcile.lock; do not create a second lock.
non_goals: Does not run a bare `git worktree prune`.
Does not implement the disk rmtree/compaction itself (delegates to cleanup_state / stale-disk-reapers).
Does not reproduce harness/state_reconciler.py whole — additive append only.
Does not run a live daemon / integration and does not flip autowork.state_reconcile.
spec.implementation_notes: Append the new function inside the existing __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ R-ANCHOR additive region. Order the gates ownership -> allowlist -> dirty (fail-CLOSED non-git) -> STAGED_UNMERGED before acquiring the lock and delegating to cleanup_state. For reclamation, enumerate registered worktrees and prune only the scoped stale staging worktree after confirming siblings remain registered; never shell out to a bare `git worktree prune`.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Reuses the oracle's hermetic synthesized git/non-git roots under tmp_path; observes lock acquisition and worktree subprocess calls to confirm scoped reclamation and absence of any bare `git worktree prune`.

token_budget_ratio.note: Additive function plus gate wiring; tests dominated by the shared oracle which the impl must turn GREEN.

_debug_stamping_reason: Task was only proposed by Claude.
